title: LaLiga says personal data was extracted from one of its digital platforms in a cyberattack
date_note: The article gives only the statement day.
summary: Asharq Al-Awsat reports that LaLiga said in a statement on Monday that personal data was extracted from one of its digital platforms in a cyberattack. The data of a fan platform and club data are said to be affected. The article says the size of the leak has not yet been determined, and that LaLiga's security team is analysing activity and has strengthened monitoring.
plain: Spain's football league LaLiga says a cyberattack extracted personal data from one of its digital platforms. The size of the leak is not yet known.
exec: LaLiga says fan and club data were affected; the scale has not been determined.

validation.note: One publisher read (Asharq Al-Awsat, quoting LaLiga's statement); no laliga.com notice or second outlet was found.
